title: UI风格#20 - Industrial Brutalist (工业粗野)
description: 创建第20种UI风格：工业粗野风格 - 混凝土质感、金属管道、工厂美学。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planT.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Industrial style When color palette Then features concrete grays, rust oranges, steel blues, rust browns
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#4A4A4A (混凝土), #8B4513 (锈橙), #2F4F4F (钢青), #D2691E (铁锈), #1C1C1C (炭黑)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Industrial style When typography Then uses industrial fonts: Oswald, Bebas Neue, or Russo One
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Oswald (粗体), Bebas Neue (高标题), Roboto Mono (正文)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Industrial style When layout Then exposed grid, pipe-like dividers, metal plate frames
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：可见钢筋网格、管道分隔、金属板框架、铆钉装饰

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Industrial style When UI elements Then riveted borders, concrete textures, warning stripes
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：铆钉边框、混凝土纹理、警示条纹、机械齿轮

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Industrial UI When functional Then includes industrial chat, pipe agents, gauge stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：工业风聊天、管道代理、仪表盘统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Industrial UI When copy Then uses industrial language: 'Forge', 'Smelt', 'Construct', 'Press'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'FORGE. SMELT. PRESS.'、按钮'SEND'→'FORGE'、'SUBMIT'→'PRESS'
